title: Large Bayesian VARs for Binary, Censored and Count Variables
abstract: arXiv:2506.01422v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We extend the vector autoregression (VAR) to model binary, censored, count and unrestricted variables jointly, treating missing observations of any type in the same way. Each restricted observation is linked to a latent Gaussian variable, so that the standard machinery for VARs, such as shrinkage priors, stochastic volatility and outlier components, applies directly to the VAR for the latent variables. The latent variables have a truncated normal conditional distribution with a banded precision matrix, from which they are drawn, jointly or equation by equation, using Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, and the sampler scales well to high dimensions. A simulation study shows that treating restricted variables as continuous distorts the levels and scales of the system and worsens forecasts of the restricted outcomes in most designs. translated_title: 用于二元、删失和计数变量的大型贝叶斯VAR模型
translated_abstract: 我们将向量自回归（VAR）扩展至联合建模二元、删失、计数和无约束变量，并以相同方式处理任何类型的缺失观测。每个受约束的观测都与一个潜在高斯变量相关联，因此VAR的标准工具，如收缩先验、随机波动率和异常值成分，可以直接应用于潜在变量的VAR。潜在变量具有带带状精度矩阵的截断正态条件分布，可使用哈密顿蒙特卡洛方法从该分布中联合地或逐方程地抽取样本，且该采样器在高维情况下具有良好的可扩展性。模拟研究表明，将受约束变量视为连续变量会扭曲系统的水平和尺度，并在大多数设计下恶化对受约束结果的预测。在一项针对25个美国宏观金融变量的应用中，我们估计了商业周期指标、银行（强度……摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种扩展的贝叶斯VAR模型，通过将受约束观测与潜在高斯变量关联并采用哈密顿蒙特卡洛采样，能够联合且高效地建模二元、删失、计数与连续变量，并可良好扩展至高维宏观金融数据。
en_tdlr: This paper extends Bayesian VARs by linking restricted observations to latent Gaussian variables and using Hamiltonian Monte Carlo sampling, enabling joint and efficient modeling of binary, censored, count, and continuous variables that scales well to high-dimensional macro-financial data.
